body: Ruling on the PR1 C1/C2 boundary: AGREED. PR1 ships zero-reader refusal (plus unknown/dead refusal and the named multi-reader warning) and NO --queue-for-role. subject: STORY-1843 PR1 boundary: agreed (refusal now, queue+receipts in PR2)
